text: Just as three streams of the Ganges, falling upon the head of Rudra, merge to form a single stream, similarly, the unmanifested (Avyakta) consisting of three gunas produces the manifested (Vyakta). Or, just as gathered threads produce a cloth, in the same way, the unmanifested produces Mahat and others through the accumulation of the gunas. Thus, the manifested world evolves from the combination of the three gunas.
